profile.summary: It is not the strongest of the species that survives, nor the most intelligent, but the one most responsive to change.

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
- Implemented comprehensive full-stack development of the site, including front-end UI/UX design and back end infrastructure.
- Designed and developed secure and scalable features,
 including data handling, matchmaking algorithms, and identity verification using PHP and API integrations.
- Managed codebase and project updates using Git version control.

positions.title: Responsive Web Developer
positions.description:
- Independently executed complete website overhauls for Contours Medical Aesthetics and its sister company, New England Reproductive Medicine & Surgery (NERMAS).
- Developed an e-commerce platform for Contours skincare products, incorporating new branding, digital marketing strategies, and workflow automation.
- Utilized HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React to enhance website functionality and user experience.
- Achieved over 500% increase in online sales within the first two months of the Contours Store launch.
- Boosted online engagement by 300% through consistent brand design and active social media presence.
- Increased daily website impressions by 1,000% through effective SEO and content management.

projects.title: Expense Tracker Web App
projects.description: This project is a full-stack Expense Tracker web application aimed at showcasing backend development skills, security best practices, and robust version control. Built using Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and React, it includes features for tracking expenses, visualizing spending patterns, and categorizing expenses over customizable timeframes. The application is set up to be highly modular, with a clear separation between development (dev) and production (prod) branches.

projects.title: Anonymous Message Board
projects.description: A secure message board that allows users to post and reply to messages anonymously, with features like encryption, moderation, and reporting.
